title: Need fingernails to open it
text: Need fingernails to open it. I had to send it back because my husband couldn't open it. I have slight nails and was able to slide them under the probe and lift it up. He was not able to do so. Instead we ordered the Harbor Instant Read Cooking Thermometer, which got good reviews and is similar looking but looks to have an easy lift probe. [[ASIN:B01DISPQJ0 Habor Instant Read Cooking Thermometer High-performing Digital Food meat Thermometer]]
